title: Twin Babies Peeking from Vintage Pram, 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot capturing two baby infants, likely twins, peeking over the side of a deep pram or dual carriage outside on a sunny day. In the sloping background, another figure sits relaxed beside a pathway or garden incline. The reverse side exhibits black album mounting paper remnants and a faint purple stamped number '21'.
